Package ch.colabproject.colab.api.controller

Class EntityGatheringBagForPropagation

java.lang.Object
ch.colabproject.colab.api.controller.EntityGatheringBagForPropagation
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
@RequestScoped public class EntityGatheringBagForPropagation extends Object implements Serializable
Transaction sidekick used to collect updated and deleted entities. Once the transaction is completed, precompute messages to propagate through websocket channels.
Author:
maxence
